diagnosis: The V11 partial loop has a deterministic source-to-served race: both served Chromium workflows trigger on current-tree/control-v11/** source changes but open GitHub Pages without a preceding publication or served-byte identity gate. G000014/G000015 therefore correctly observed repaired main bytes alongside stale served bytes.
intervention: Refined the already-materialized V11 publication successor instead of creating a duplicate. Its definition of done now explicitly requires reuse of the existing publication owner, a publication-or-served-byte-identity prerequisite before Chromium, and forbids a parallel publisher or force-updating gh-pages.

tests.name: workflow_trigger_vs_publish_audit
tests.detail: Both V11 served workflows trigger on owner source changes and run served browser verification; neither workflow contains a source-to-gh-pages publication step before browser verification.

tests.name: duplicate_successor_avoidance
tests.detail: Critic refined the existing semantic successor rather than creating a second job for the same residual.

remaining_boundary: Actual publication and served Chromium rerun require the successor's repository/browser capabilities and remain outside this Critic unit.
